newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse rallies, further gains expected.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse rallies, further gains expected.

text.p: A bullish mood at the Bucharest bourse sent most prices higher on Tuesday with traders saying the uptrend would continue in the next session.
Turnover soared to 93.59 million lei at the exchange's first session this week from last Thursday's 16.97 million lei.
Fertiliser maker Azomures SA remained the star of the bourse, taking 60 percent of the total turnover. Azomures gained 1,400 lei, to close at 15,700 lei.
Traders said a depreciation of the leu currency over the past days had made listings on the exchange more attractive for foreign investors in the fledging stock exchange.
The leu dropped about nine percent to 4,700/800 to the dollar so far this week and is seen falling further amid fears of higher inflation after expected energy price rises.
On Tuesday ten stocks edged up, three closed weaker and four had no trades. Private syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended pending an announcement.
Traders said the market was expected to become more liquid.

"There are some foreign buyers who started to show interest in the Romanian market," one said. "It appears they are confident the new government will fulfil its promises so we expect them to inject some fresh money on the market".
Traders said some profit-taking might cap down the current bullish mood next week.

Impact Bucuresti construction firm closed weaker at 17,000 lei, down from 17,300 lei. Carbid Fox Tirnaveni chemical products maker also lost 210 lei to close at 1,940 and Electroceramica Turda insulator maker closed lower at 8,100 lei, down from 9,000 in the previous session.
Two unofficial indices - the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA and Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- rose by 3.9 percent and 3.79 percent from the previous session.
